source.landing_page: https://rasp2.zhanglab.net/download/ (RASP v2; track Bsubtilis/SHAPE-seq_NAR_2022_Cheng/yxjA_EQR_220_rep1-pos.bw; Cheng et al. 2022 NAR, doi:10.1093/nar/gkac102)

mask_reason: Leading run of 3 exact zeros at the 5' end (full-length extension end of SHAPE-seq reads; same rule as RNASEP_DMS_0000).

report_notes.construct: B. subtilis yxjA (nupG) purine riboswitch leader, 220-nt in vitro transcript (genome NC_000964.3:4005524-4005743, + strand, ends 8 nt before the nupG start), equilibrium-refolded ('EQR'), probed with BzCN SHAPE-seq, replicate 1. Cheng et al. 2022 NAR 50:12001. Numbering = genome coordinate.
report_notes.region: R = 4005527-4005576 (transcript nt 4-53): the first 50 nt with data, 5'-anchored windows.
data_caveats: Refolding buffer, Mg2+ and temperature are not given in the paper's Methods; RNAfold folds at an assumed 37 °C. Ligand presence in the EQR samples was not verified (Results suggest no 2-aminopurine).
Track values are RASP's 'raw' SHAPE-seq reactivities; one value (transcript nt 80, rho ~ 137) is an outlier, which does not matter for Spearman correlation but would for a linear one.
Of the equilibrium transcript lengths in RASP (135, 160, 220 nt) the longest was chosen, so the window test has the most room.
limitations: Experimental conditions are partly unknown (see Data caveats).
BzCN SHAPE-seq: all four nucleotides are evaluated.
